added_failures_note: The reviewed run records baseline_suite and after_suite as not run because the node changes no product source or test, so there is no gate-log pair to derive added failures from. The derived figure is zero added failures over zero compared runs, not a measured green.

findings.summary: The JSON carries no classification, fix or failing-test field, although the done_when requires the html AND its JSON to hold the classification and, for case (a), the fix with its test; the machine-readable artifact therefore answers half the brief and a reader taking the JSON alone finds per-member predicates without a verdict. Fold into the node that implements the reset fix, which must re-run this measurement anyway.

The recorded gate log names revision 46a127882, the node's first commit, while the node landed at 2a32deacf twenty minutes later, so the deterministic-uuid change and the rewritten JSON are covered by no gate run and the promotion receipt will fill from a log that predates the head. Re-run the check at the head.

guards records graph_writes 0, llm_calls 0 and spend_usd 0.0 as hardcoded literals rather than as measurements, so the zero cannot distinguish a run that wrote from one that did not; that the queries are read-only MATCH/RETURN is what actually establishes the guard, and it is visible in the file.

The assertion that the anchor is excluded by the reset step's eligibility runs that query over all five members and returns two eligible, so the batch-level eligible == 0 the diagnosis turns on is measured nowhere in the gate; it rests on anchor_gated_batches, which I confirmed at campaign.py:500-514 and harmonize.py:1266 but which the gate never evaluates.

findings_note: Findings are recorded with the severity each states; none is blocking.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states the gate command, its log path, the classification, the anchor's excluding predicate, and reports baseline_suite and after_suite as not run because the node changes no product source.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the four declared paths from the source prompt (html, json, run.py, figure directory); every path in both commits is inside them and nothing else was written.

justifications.durability: The gate at shc-family-eligibility-diagnosis-run.py:392-453 reddens if the live graph moves, but nothing asserts the early return at graph_docs_persistence.py:410, so a fix landing there leaves every assertion green while the fragment still declares the defect.
justifications.evidence: The gate at shc-family-eligibility-diagnosis-run.py:382-459 asserts 17 conditions and its log records EXIT=0, but the log header names revision 46a127882 while the node landed at 2a32deacf, and the batch-level zero the diagnosis turns on is read from code rather than measured.
justifications.fit: The fragment follows the repository's evidence trio and figure conventions, uses a project-absolute img src, and introduces no plan label or version suffix in any name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/shc-family-eligibility-diagnosis.html:36-45 names each member's first excluding predicate and traces the anchor's to the anchor-gated first batchn and the early return at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_docs_persistence.py:410, which I confirmed precedes the scope stamp at lines 418-423.
justifications.reuse: No read-only per-predicate eligibility evaluator exists in imas_codex/standard_names — a capability search over that tree for eligibility helpers returns only write-claim owners — and the transcription at shc-family-eligibility-diagnosis-run.py:44-95 is guarded against the owning source by inspect.getsource.
